outcome: Pilot validation on Phoenix: one safe independent P3 item through the normal runner/test/evaluation path, following the onboarding doc (Greg 2026-10-16)
acceptance: Before anything starts, a report goes to Greg via Engram::Advisor naming the proposed Phoenix P3 item, why it is safe and isolated, the exact session/project route (whether Phoenix is already a TermAl project with an eligible root session), and the one UI action Greg must take; Greg's reply is recorded on this item verbatim, and nothing starts before it.

On Greg's go and on current master, the chosen item runs through the normal runner, test and evaluation path following only docs/features/supervised-pilot-onboarding.md (review-clean version), and the host-recorded test check and the acceptance evaluation are cited on this item with their ids.

A note lists every step where the operator had to deviate from or guess beyond the doc (quoting the doc line and what was done instead), or states none were needed; each deviation is forwarded to the onboarding doc's holder as a doc fix.
